api.Config: Config(cadence_s=60, n_candidates=32, wm_samples=8, horizon_s=600, p_star=0.8). Samples >=2; horizon must equal 600; p_star must equal 0.8.
api.score_moves: score_moves(record, rng, *, rollout, calibration, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None) -> dict. Simulator-independent scoring boundary shared with dense teachers.
api.observation: ego_id, group, rows, time_s, commands, policy_residuals, policy_state, policy_radio; optional history, world_id, state_id, committed_offsets. Rows/history are whitelisted, causal and ego-local. Group includes ego and 1..4 observed CAVs.
api.policy_radio: Required for ALL online actors, including plain 33-input MAPPO. Contains current frame, previous_commands, deterministic, complete observed-CAV noise, generator_state, log_std and intent. intent is null unless the actor supports intent features; then it includes horizon, prior timestamped board, learned head and bounds. Missing sampling state or current residuals fails closed.
api.Continuation: planner_policy.Continuation(record, policy=None). residuals(state, ids, tick) resets every branch at tick zero and reuses current live samples. Subsequent whole-second decisions continue independent actor/noise/RNG/radio/intent state. observe_issued(state, command, tick) receives post-safety issued commands. Candidate release continues that branch's base policy over the full horizon.
api.moves_dependency: Lazy tools.coopmwm.moves: FAMILIES, candidates(obs_state, rng, n), offsets(move, t). Members are restricted to record['group']; no production stub.
api.calibration_dependency: Lazy tools.coopmwm.planner_calibration.calibrate_probability(p_raw, calibration), or explicit calibrate adapter. Mandatory finite probability in [0,1]; no raw fallback.
api.rollout: Callable(record, actions, K, H) -> {action_id: K paired costs or team_delay dictionaries}; lower cost is better; common future indices.
api.WMRollout: WMRollout(runtime, memory=None, chunk_actions=4) requires CPU WM/policy parameters and calls plan_wm.evaluate with trim=False, final_chain=True, require_policy_radio=True and full H.
api.legacy_compatibility: plan_wm.evaluate defaults require_policy_radio=False; plan_executor defaults policy_radio=None. Unrelated callers without continuation state retain legacy behavior; policy_wm.py remains unchanged.
api.selection: Explicit none id='policy' continues the base actor. p_raw counts strictly positive paired gains. Calibration is mandatory. Select the greatest positive expected gain with calibrated P >= 0.8, using stable ties.
api.OnlinePlanner: OnlinePlanner(*, rollout, calibration, rng, accel_bounds, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None, world_id=None). Separate move RNG. apply(..., sample, desired, policy, policy_radio=None) returns pre-safety requests.
api.runtime_hook: v2v_runtime.controller_class(acceleration.Controller)(policy, generator, deterministic, planner_online=planner); omission/None is OFF. Enabled runtime captures sampling state for plain/V2V/intent actors. Competing guide/replay/branch producers are refused.
api.execution: Cadence replanning replaces ongoing moves; failures/rejections return to base. Offset expiry or member/contact loss releases the move. Shared observable commitments appear in both arms. Full look-ahead stays 600 seconds.
api.single_writer: Only modifies pre-safety requests and sample action record; own_action remains sampled base. Existing CommandOwnership is sole plant writer, speedMode 27; no HDV commands.
api.events: Enabled planner_online events contain decisions, paired scores, calibrated probabilities, failures and offsets. Default-off serialized events and policy RNG match track-base. Actor loading preserves global torch RNG.
